findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_news, get_forward_estimates, get_operating_kpis, get_earnings_call_transcript, list_research_shortlist, get_portfolio_context, get_capabilities, compare_company_exposures · Private data: get_etf_exposures · Public sink: search_stocks, find_stock_peers, get_etf_index_group, get_stock_metrics, get_financial_history, get_quality_moat_metrics, get_forward_estimates, list_research_shortlist, save_research_shortlist, get_capabilities, get_company_risk · Destructive: screen_stocks, compare_etfs, get_company_relationships, get_company_risk_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_news, get_forward_estimates, get_operating_kpis, get_earnings_call_transcript, list_research_shortlist, get_portfolio_context, get_capabilities, compare_company_exposures · Private data: get_etf_exposures · Public sink: search_stocks, find_stock_peers, get_etf_index_group, get_stock_metrics, get_financial_history, get_quality_moat_metrics, get_forward_estimates, list_research_shortlist, save_research_shortlist, get_capabilities, get_company_risk · Destructive: screen_stocks, compare_etfs, get_company_relationships, get_company_risk_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

Reports whether you are authenticated and as WHICH identity (email + userId), whether the account has Bullrun Pro and why (subscription / trial / admin), the granted " → after: "Discover what the connected Bullrun account can do BEFORE attempting an action, so you can plan instead of learning by hitting a 403. Reports whether you are authenticated and as WHICH identity (email + userId), the account's Pro/trial status and why (subscription / trial / admin), the granted OAuth"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
